count_contract: Sum canonical primary P2 selected-side counts per exact law/procedure/history/product. Group by side selected before outcomes. Complete Leaf/C02 laws replace matching partial parent P2 views; other parametric laws and D1/D2 prior-only subsets retain their supported populations. Never pool F fixed panel or matched-control variants.
coverage: Full source opportunity universe includes every category offer in all three weeks. Missing law-week rows are unavailable forecasts; unknown/missing outcomes among actual selections retain their states. Selected fallback is explicit origin, separately from admitted-pool fallback.
probability_scores: Count-only closure; cumulative all-law proper scores remain separate. Do not substitute all-law Brier for selected-side Brier.
uncertainty: Existing500 whole-game sensitivity bootstrap seed1703 from saved WIN/LOSS states when>=8games; three weeks insufficient for registered whole-week CI. Exposed, descriptive, no selection/multiplicity adjustment.
validation: Independently reconcile summed counts against exact retained selected direction/statistical-state rows. No threshold crossing, CDF, probabilities or selection decisions recomputed.
